data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 13.504m in technical provisions (change in prior year provisions), reducing gross claims outstanding from GBP 136.846m at 1 January 2016. On a net of reinsurance basis the report states a favourable movement of GBP 9.1m included in claims incurred, arising across classes including Accident & Health, Marine, Fire and other damage to property, Third party liability and Miscellaneous, partially offset by an adverse movement in reinsurance. The movement is driven by favourable claims development and recoveries from reinsurers.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, liabilities) 2015 comparative column. Prior year movement taken from Technical provisions note 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross). The report also states a net favourable movement of GBP 9.1m (net of reinsurance) in the Claims note; lob movements in this extraction use the class-level net amounts presented in the Claims note (confidence lowered). Claims development triangle (gross) is present and was used to list underwriting years; triangle used as corroboration but the explicit gross 'Change in prior year provisions' was used as primary source.
